subject: Goblin Minion
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. Outline art only. A small goblin minion runs through a dungeon kitchen. He has exactly two legs, both attached at the hips. One foot is on the floor. The other leg kicks back in a normal run. No extra limb. No broken knee. Under one arm he carries a large ham, a simple oval with a bone handle. Big pointed ears, long nose, scrawny body. Hanging pots, wooden table, closed pantry door, stone ceiling, large floor slabs. No words. Bold even outlines. No black fills, no page frame.
